description: For a person riding or running a multi-day tour or stage event of their own: a GPX per stage (attached files, links, or a Ride with GPS collection) and the first day's date and start time make one tour with a day per stage, saved privately for them, each day armed: on the day they press Start on their Garmin (livedot field) or Go live in the app on that day's route and they're live on it. The days are ordered by the numbers in the file names, else by the map, one day after another from start, skipping rest_days. Returns their follow link on livedot.me and the days. A route can also come from another app's tool as its points or an encoded polyline (for example a route or activity map from a fitness app): pass it as polyline or points. Never ask the user to export a GPX if you already have the route's points.

files.description: A GPX per stage, as the user gave them.

items.description: A GPX file (its text, or a link to it) or a route's polyline or points, and its name (the name helps order the days).

download_url.description: ChatGPT: the attached file's download link.

points.description: The day as its points, [[lat, lon], …].

polyline.description: The day as an encoded polyline (another app's route or activity map).

url.description: A link to the GPX or route (Ride with GPS; not Strava).

gpx_files.description: Several GPX or route files the user attached (ChatGPT passes them here): one per day of a tour, ordered by the numbers in their names, else by the map.

items.description: One attached GPX or route file.

file_name.description: Its name, if known (the route's name; never an event's).

name.description: The tour's name, if the user said it.

rest_days.description: Dates with no riding or running, "YYYY-MM-DD", only if the user named them.

sport.description: ride (cycling, Windline) or run (running, RunFast). Leave it out when the account has only one.

start.description: Day 1's local start, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM" (the same time every day unless starts says otherwise). Ask if they didn't say.

starts.description: Each day's own local start, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM", when they differ.

tz.description: IANA time zone; else worked out from where day 1 starts.

units.description: Pass the asker's units: imperial for users in the US, UK road distances, Liberia or Myanmar, or when they ask in miles/°F; otherwise metric.

url.description: A Ride with GPS collection (one day per route), instead of files.

name: add_my_tour

outputSchema.description: Their own tour, a day per stage, each day armed.

app.description: The account's app: windline or runfast.

armed.description: What starts it on the day, in words.

days.description: Each day: day, label, from, to, km, start (ISO), date, time.

error.description: When the call failed: what went wrong, in words for the user.

event.description: The tour: { id, name, dashboard?, link? }.

follow_url.description: Their follow link on livedot.me (their livedot name, else their own follow link).

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the user (no match, not live yet, a question back).

order.description: How the days were ordered (numbers, map or upload).

signup.description: Without a sign-in: { label, url } to make a free Windline or RunFast account (?ref=mcp).

sponsor_line.description: The line every answer ends with: who brings livedot's live tracking free.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" when there is nothing to show (see message).
